messages:
nick: Quick sync - need a concise solution brief + two launch posts + webinar blurb focused on deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Emphasize security controls, SLA tiers, and inbound routing.
aj: I can draft the one-pager and one social post. Need SLA/latency numbers from eng to avoid broad claims.
tara: Field requests a one-line compare: risk profile | SLA tier | recommended buyer. Also a short intake timeline for Dedicated evals.
ops-bot: Benchmarks uploaded: /benchmarks/deploy_mode_snapshot.csv (shows ~20-30% unit cost improvement with batching + KV caching depending on model/seq).
nick: We'll use conservative wording: "up to 30%" with footnote about variability. CTA: "Request a Dedicated Eval" for enterprise flows, plus "Start a Trial" for smaller teams.
aj: Draft outline: TL;DR; mode-at-a-glance; security; SLA snapshot; benchmark callout; field next steps + CTAs; webinar link. I'll post drafts by 10:00am PT tomorrow.
tara: I'll prep the field intake paragraph and timeline (2-6 weeks) and compress the compare row.
ops-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Deploy Modes for Regulated Apps" 2026-07-14 09:00 PT. Registration: https://events.redwood/deploy-modes-2026
nick: Great  aim to review drafts at 10:30 PT. React with :thumbsup: when done.
